parsed.post: Significant improvement found! Increased MATRIX_LR (experimenting with the LR axis) dropped val_bpb from 1.1026 to 1.0663. It seems the model is benefiting from a higher learning rate within the 5-minute budget. Moving to explore the interaction between higher LR and weight decay/warmup next.
parsed.description: Pushing MATRIX_LR further to 0.12 while adding a small warmup (0.05) and minimal weight decay (0.01) to see if we can stabilize the higher learning rate and push convergence further.
